page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a high memory-to-core ratio provides a stable resource density for memory-bound workloads without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the dedicated Intel Xeon processor cores, the ecs.hfr9i.4xlarge is designed for memory-intensive applications. Suitable workloads include relational and non-relational databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and medium-scale data processing tasks that require consistent CPU performance and a large memory footprint.
